frontend/src/pages/Voices/components/met.purpose: suggestRecordingPrompt(attrs) — scores VoiceAttributes against the 39 archetypes (class/gender/age exact-match + tone/timbre Jaccard overlap + pace); exact/close match returns that archetype's prompt verbatim, otherwise composes a fallback from a Class-opening line + Pace-cue + tone/timbre fragments. Pure, no API call — mirrors iconPrompt.ts's buildIconPrompt() pattern.
notes: 2026-07-12: SuggestionResult gains sampleText: string | null. suggestRecordingPrompt() returns the matched archetype's sample_text when confidence is close/exact; composeFallback() (the no-close-match path) always returns sampleText: null -- deliberately no composed fallback for spoken sample text, since an invented line is worse than leaving whatever's already set alone.
Returns null when attrs is absent/empty — caller (ScriptEditor.tsx) disables its Suggest button in that case rather than showing a generic suggestion.
Thresholds are named constants (EXACT_THRESHOLD=10, CLOSE_THRESHOLD=6 of a 12-point max) validated against the real 39-archetype data before tests were written.
